Camera elevated 35 degrees, macro 70mm tilt-shift look, tiny painted safety workers, fine model seams, subtle bevel at front edge of pale concrete diorama base, translucent sculpted blue resin water; restrained depth falloff only far back and very front, primary cargo crisp. Bright diffuse daylight, white/light gray, deep navy and selective cyan #00ABE1, kraft cartons. Physically plausible premium model, not clay, not cartoon, not glossy plastic.
Composition and story: the eye travels continuously LEFT TO RIGHT across nearly the FULL WIDTH. Left third is Chinese inland departure: compressed generic dense Chinese coastal city industrial skyline, orderly Chinese port cargo stacks, one clearly recognizable red Chinese flag with yellow stars on a realistic thin flagpole. Do not replicate any real landmark, city, facility or service route. Middle foreground: one distinctive CYAN 40-foot corrugated container with black corner castings, off-white rectangular long side sign panel BLANK for original logo compositing later. Tiny forklift approaches it with kraft cartons held by cyan straps. Right side: container crane loading a navy-hull ocean freighter at its stern; ship's BOW points RIGHT toward open Pacific water at far right. Same hero container will recur on ship/truck later. Frame must SHOW THE SHIP AND OPEN SEA as next destination, not just a warehouse. Country cues are contextual not giant flags. One grounded cyan yard line leads left through cargo toward quayside; no road/stripe on water. Camera looks from inland yard toward departure water; no frontal facade centered composition. Model base on continuous pale background with no large dead white left half. Keep only TOP LEFT 24% width by 16% height quiet pale sky for optional HTML label; scene spans entire lower canvas.
Important: NO PNPLINE lettering, no invented logo, no labels/captions, no arbitrary digits or pseudo-text. The hero container sign panel stays clean blank matte ivory, prominent near lower center and readable in mild perspective, unobscured. No oversized people, no generic isolated warehouse tile, no collage, no multi-panel storyboard, no neon, no excessive bokeh. Single coherent detailed miniature port set, cinematic left-to-right outward travel. The CHINESE flag is explicitly permitted and essential for country legibility.
review: Chinese flag and dense coastal city; model base and tiny figurines; cargo left to ship right; broad hero blank container panel; some tiny incidental industrial markings remain.
